open.default: Thanks for joining, {name}! Before we dive in—quick context check: aapne form mein mention kiya tha '{pain_snippet}'... yeh still top priority hai ya kuch aur shift ho gaya?
open.high_urgency: {name}, appreciate you prioritizing this. Dekha maine form mein urgency high thi—kya trigger hua recently jo isse urgent bana diya?

diagnose.revenue_impact: Got it. Toh basically yeh pain aapke revenue ko directly impact kar raha—agar quantify karo toh kitna revenue table pe chhod rahe ho monthly due to this?
diagnose.operational_pain: Samajh gaya. Yeh operational level pe kitna bandwidth le raha tumhara aur team ka? Hours mein bol sakte ho weekly?
diagnose.strategic_gap: Makes sense. Strategy level pe agar yeh solve ho jaye in next 60-90 days, company trajectory kaise change hoti?

align_outcome.default: Perfect. Toh end outcome jo chahiye—tumhare words mein—kya hai? Agar main 90 days mein deliver karunga toh success kaisi dikhegi?
align_outcome.specific: Clear hai. Toh specifically: pipeline predictable chahiye, conversion {target}%+, aur cycle {timeline} se kam. Sahi samjha?

budget_anchor.high_ticket: Cool. Ab investment side—tumne budget mention kiya tha {budget_range}. Agar hum deliver kare yeh outcome consistently, ROI toh easily {roi_multiple}x hoga in 6-12 months. Make sense?
budget_anchor.retainer: Investment-wise, hamara typical engagement ₹{ticket} hai as retainer for {duration} months. Isme aapka system build hoga, team train hogi, aur predictable results milenge. Comfortable lag raha?
budget_anchor.pilot: Ek option hai—₹{pilot_price} ka pilot for {pilot_duration} days. Usme hum quick wins deliver karenge aur validation milegi. Phir full engagement decide kar sakte. Sound fair?

objection_handlers.budget_tight: I get it—budget always tight hota. But yeh dekhte hain: currently jo revenue/pipeline chhoot raha due to this pain, woh kitna hai monthly? Agar {lost_revenue} chhoot raha aur investment {ticket} hai toh payback {payback_months} months. Still tight lag raha?
objection_handlers.tried_before: Fair point—pehle kisi ne deliver nahi kiya. Kya specifically miss hua tha? (Listen...) Got it. Hamara approach different hai—hum {differentiator}. Plus accountability tight hai with weekly milestones. Ek pilot try kar sakte agar comfort chahiye?
objection_handlers.need_to_think: Absolutely, sochna chahiye. But ek quick check—kya concern budget hai, timeline hai, ya trust/validation? Agar main address kar sakoon concern toh aaj decide ho sakta kya?
objection_handlers.talk_to_partner: Makes sense—partner involved hona chahiye. Kya main aaj hi 15-min call setup kar sakta partner ke saath? Ya tum internally discuss karke revert karoge—timeline kya hoga?

risk_reversal.milestone_based: Risk minimize karne ke liye milestones rakhte hain—har 2 weeks pe deliverable. Agar kisi stage pe lagta nahi chal raha toh pause/exit kar sakte. Fair?
risk_reversal.quick_win: First 14 days mein ek quick win guaranteed deliver karenge—chahe basic qualification framework ho ya messaging template. Tangible output dekhoge early.
risk_reversal.money_back: Aur agar 30 days mein visible progress nahi dikha (pipeline data/conversion improvement) toh refund kar dete hain. Skin in the game hai hamara bhi.

next_step.close_now: Perfect! Toh let's lock this—main contract aur payment link send karta hoon. Token ₹{token} aaj process kar sakte? Balance {balance} milestone-1 ke baad.
next_step.token_today: Great. Toh aaj token process karo ₹{token}—slot lock ho jayega. Implementation start hoga {start_date} se. Payment link abhi share karta?
next_step.schedule_kickoff: Awesome! Toh kickoff call schedule karte hain {kickoff_date} ko. Aapko team access, tools setup sab ready rakhna. Excited? 🚀

follow_up_templates.token_paid:
Hey {name}! Token received ✅

Kickoff: {kickoff_date}
Prep needed: Pipeline data (last 90 days), current sales process doc

Reply 'Ready' when you have these—let's gooo! 🔥
follow_up_templates.defer_with_date:
{name}, you mentioned {defer_date} tak decide karoge.

Just a quick nudge—slot hold kar rakha hai but {deadline} tak confirm karna hoga otherwise release ho jayega.

Still on? Let me know! 😊
follow_up_templates.thinking_nudge:
Hey {name},

{days} days ho gaye our call ko—soch rahe ho still ya koi concern address karna hai?

Happy to jump on a quick 10-min clarification call agar helpful ho.

Warna all good—no pressure! 🙏
